stories.title: Indy man accused of secretly recording child victim faces exploitation, CSAM charges
stories.summary: Investigators say a cyber tip led them to online accounts linked to Salomon Duarte Montoya, where they allegedly found child sex abuse material.

stories.title: 'Thanksgiving Couch Crashers' invites Hancock County families to host an adoptable dog or cat over the holidays
stories.summary: A Greenfield shelter wants you to let a furry friend visit your family this Thanksgiving, and they'll even provide the supplies!

stories.title: Off-duty Lawrence police officer pleads guilty for allegedly driving while intoxicated in Greenfield
stories.summary: Court documents say Stuart Bishop was stopped by police Saturday, June 20 around 11:30 p.m. after multiple traffic infractions.

stories.title: Ex-IMPD officer arrested for alleged child molestation
stories.summary: An Indiana State Police SWAT crew searched the former officer's home in New Palestine on Tuesday, July 22.

stories.title: Federal lawsuit alleges predator used Roblox to groom, threaten two Indiana children
stories.summary: The lawsuit alleges Roblox knew predators were actively using the platform, but marketed it safe for children anyway.

stories.title: MSD of Martinsville announces new superintendent
stories.summary: Patrick Biggerstaff will succeed Eric Bowlen, who announced earlier this year that he would retire at the end of 2026

stories.title: 'A plea out to the community' | Humane Society for Hamilton County hosting Black Friday adoption event
stories.summary: The Humane Society for Hamilton County (HSHC) will host a Black Friday adoption event to help animals in its care. Six of the animals will have adoption fees waived.

stories.title: Recount director aims to meet Dec. 20 deadline in Senate Republican leader’s tight race
stories.summary: The recount of a closely contested state Senate race involving one of Indiana’s most powerful Republicans will begin soon.

stories.title: New apartments for low-income households, adults with intellectual disabilities break ground on Indy's near southwest side
stories.summary: According to the West Indianapolis Development Corp., the units are expected to be move-in ready as early as January 2028.

stories.title: Evansville man faces multiple charges after dramatic police chase, alleged break-in and vehicle theft
stories.summary: Officers tried to tase the man as he pushed the driver out of the truck and drove off, kicking off an ISP pursuit.

stories.title: Car crashes into AT&T store on Indy's west side
stories.summary: The incident happened Nov. 23 at the store off Rockville Road, just east of Raceway Road.

stories.title: 2 adults, 2 dogs safe after smoke alarms alert them to early morning house fire in Columbus
stories.summary: The homeowner reportedly told firefighters she was on the couch when the smoke alarms went off, prompting her to get up and see the flames, the fire department said.
